create_FileShader: create a FileShader placeholder that writes source code to a temporary file for SPIR-V testing
create_FileSPIRVShader: create a FileSPIRVShader placeholder that assembles source code into a temporary SPIR-V binary file
create_ConfigFlagsFile: create a ConfigFlagsFile placeholder that generates a config file and returns the -Oconfig flag for spirv-opt
create_StdinShader: create a StdinShader placeholder that returns '-' as filename and stores source in testcase.stdin_shader
test_PlaceHolder: test the PlaceHolder base class and its instantiate_for_spirv_args and instantiate_for_expectation methods
